name: Temporary EXEC-0010 result verification and close

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/exec-0010-result-close-20260907

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  verify-close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out canonical execution branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: eose/exec-0010-result-close-20260907
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Materialize exact EXEC-0010 worktree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin wp/mvp-0005
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/wp/mvp-0005)" = "d01b8ae86e0faad3624f6d64065d32b97ff69b5e"
          git branch wp/mvp-0005 origin/wp/mvp-0005
          WT=/home/runner/work/monad/.monad-worktrees/wp-mvp-0005
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$WT")"
          git worktree add "$WT" wp/mvp-0005
          test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "d01b8ae86e0faad3624f6d64065d32b97ff69b5e"
          test "$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)" = "wp/mvp-0005"

      - name: Verify execution contract before result
        run: ./scripts/eos contract verify EXEC-0010

      - name: Write structured execution result
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > /home/runner/work/monad/.monad-worktrees/wp-mvp-0005/.eos-result-EXEC-0010.json <<'JSON'
          {
            "execution_id": "EXEC-0010",
            "target": "WP-MVP-0005",
            "status": "completed",
            "summary": "Implemented the bounded semantic adapter for canonical monad.toml in monad-core, including deterministic source/document identity, canonical versus CLI-effective provenance, fail-closed invalid-input diagnostics, legacy-manifest non-authority, inert configuration text, exact-byte/effective-state binding, and retained reliable TOML byte ranges.",
            "changed_files": [
              "crates/monad-core/src/config.rs",
              "crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs",
              "crates/monad-core/src/identity.rs",
              "crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs",
              "crates/monad-core/src/workspace.rs",
              "machine/corpus.jsonl",
              "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/config.rs.json",
              "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs.json",
              "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/identity.rs.json",
              "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs.json",
              "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/workspace.rs.json",
              "machine/graph.json",
              "machine/manifest.json"
            ],
            "validation": [
              {"command": "cargo fmt --all -- --check", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Formatting check passed on the clean EXEC-0010 lineage."},
              {"command": "cargo test -p monad-core", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "All 131 monad-core tests passed, including exact-byte provenance and TOML source-range regressions."},
              {"command": "cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::large_enum_variant", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Scoped strict Clippy passed; only the explicitly excluded pre-existing unrelated large-enum lint is exempted."},
              {"command": "python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py && python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Trace and deterministic machine projections are synchronized on the clean execution lineage."},
              {"command": "EXEC-0010 baseline-diff scope audit", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Baseline-to-result diff contains only five monad-core source files and eight machine projections; no .eos or governed artifact path is present."}
            ],
            "acceptance_criteria": [
              {"criterion": "US-015 valid monad.toml becomes a deterministic semantic document record.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Semantic config parser tests establish stable TOML source/document identity, exact content hash and byte length, deterministic canonical path, and repeatable serialized output."},
              {"criterion": "US-016 schema/parse errors remain diagnostics and block a valid semantic config document.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Malformed TOML, duplicate keys, unknown keys, unsupported schema versions, invalid UTF-8, and stale effective state fail closed through structured diagnostics."},
              {"criterion": "US-017 normalized semantic representation is deterministic and retains source/effective-value provenance distinctions.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Canonical file/default values remain distinct from CLI-effective values; ordered maps and serialization are deterministic."},
              {"criterion": ".monad/manifest.yaml cannot override or become a competing semantic config source.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Legacy-manifest non-authority regression passes and serialized semantic state contains no manifest authority."},
              {"criterion": "No environment interpolation, command substitution, network lookup, or include execution occurs.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Executable-looking and interpolation/include/network-like strings remain inert parser data in regression coverage."},
              {"criterion": "Effective configuration is bound to the exact source bytes identified by the semantic document.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Rebound validation rejects stale or unrelated effective configuration for different monad.toml bytes."},
              {"criterion": "Reliable TOML source ranges are retained for downstream diagnostics and provenance explanations.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Spanned TOML values are retained as deterministic semantic-path to byte-range mappings and verified against exact source slices."}
            ],
            "risks": [
              "The CLI-provenance rebinding helper must be intentionally extended if future bootstrap-supported CLI override fields are added."
            ],
            "unresolved_issues": [],
            "proposed_commit_message": "feat(core): parse canonical Monad configuration"
          }
          JSON

      - name: Ingest and independently verify result
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          RESULT=/home/runner/work/monad/.monad-worktrees/wp-mvp-0005/.eos-result-EXEC-0010.json
          ./scripts/eos execution ingest EXEC-0010 "$RESULT"
          ./scripts/eos execution check EXEC-0010
          test "$(python3 - <<'PY'
          import csv
          with open('.eos/executions.tsv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              rows = list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t'))
          print(next(r['status'] for r in rows if r['id'] == 'EXEC-0010'))
          PY
          )" = "VERIFIED"

      - name: Close execution and remove worktree
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos execution close EXEC-0010 --reason "Bounded structured-configuration implementation result independently verified" --by chatgpt
          ./scripts/eos worktree remove WP-MVP-0005

      - name: Regenerate and strictly verify canonical projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Publish canonical EXEC-0010 result state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git rm .github/workflows/tmp-exec-0010-result-close.yml
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check -- .eos machine
          git commit -m "chore(eose): verify and close EXEC-0010"
          git push origin HEAD:eose/exec-0010-result-close-20260907
